summary.text: The Four Masters of the Yuan dynasty … is a name used to collectively describe the four Chinese painters: Huang Gongwang, Wu Zhen, Ni Zan, and Wang Meng, who were active during the Yuan dynasty (1271–1368).

source.author: Wikipedia contributors
source.title: Four Masters of the Yuan dynasty

summary.text: They worked in a free technique, chiefly in ink and light colours. The first two were almost exclusively landscapists. … The quality which all alike sought was i (Japanese itsu), “ aloofness,” — the opposite of schwarmerei, turgidity, facile emotionalism, popular appeal.

source.author: Arthur Waley
source.title: An Introduction to the Study of Chinese Painting
